summary: Nuwa Capital is a Dubai-based venture firm with offices listed in Dubai, Riyadh and Cairo that describes itself as a founder-first investment platform for the MENA technology ecosystem, supported by strategic investor Al Faisaliah Group. Its homepage features portfolio companies such as Tapper, Mantas and Gowit and insight posts on investment decisions.
